newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends easy as banks take position.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends easy as banks take position.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed lower at 42.5490/5500 to the dollar in interbank trading on Wednesday against Tuesday's closing at 42.5460/5490.
The local unit was quoted at 42.5480/5500 in early trading and weakened further in the absence of selling offers, dealers said.
The taka gained ground against the dollar on Tuesday after the central bank made no downward adjustments of the local unit, dealers said.
"We expected Tuesday's trend to continue. But the correction seemed short-lived. Sellers turned back again and some buyers had to go to the central bank," said one dealer.
He gave no reason for the reversal of the trend but said the banks were seeking to keep long dollar positions.
